card.text: M68 is a globular star cluster in the Milky Way, about 10,400 parsecs away.

sources.quote: Messier 68 is a globular cluster found in the east south-east of Hydra, away from its precisely equatorial part.

introduction.text: M68 is drawn as 781 of its member stars, measured by Gaia; each dot sits at its sky position, at the cluster's distance.
